why: Checks 1, 2 and 4 test only what their expect lines say. Check 1's cases (bounds, lo===hi, negative ranges, floats) all fall under "returns x limited to the range lo to hi". Check 2 tests only that lo>hi throws a RangeError. Check 4 is just `npm test`. Check 3 breaks the criterion. Its expect line only requires that README.md "documents every function math.js exports". Its PASS needs a regex `'^#+\\s*'+n+'\\s*\\('` to exit 0, so each export must have a Markdown heading with the name followed by "(". FAIL also says "has no heading or no description". Exports documented in a list or table without headings would fail even though the words are met. That format rule is stricter than the words, so it belongs under Advisory, not in PASS/FAIL.
